functions.name: F_4x4TransformMatrixFrom3Ints
functions.summary: Constructs a 4x4 diagonal scale matrix over eight qword slots in a1 from three integer inputs (a2, a3, a4) using 3DNow! intrinsics: a2 becomes the low dword of slot 0, a3 is shifted left 32 bits into the high dword of slot 2, a4 becomes the low dword of slot 5, slot 7 carries the homogeneous 1.0 constant, and slots 1, 3, 4, 6 are zeroed.

Shift a3 left 32 bits to place it in the high dword of slot 2
Store the shifted a3 into slot 2 at offset 16
Zero slot 3 at offset 24
Zero slot 4 at offset 32
Store a4 as the low dword of slot 5 at offset 40
Zero slot 6 at offset 48
Store the homogeneous 1.0 qword constant into slot 7 at offset 56
Return the output matrix base a1
